name: Shop / Jewellery store
description: Show collections, book a store visit, ask for price, talk to staff.

nodes.text: Hi {{name}} 👋 Welcome to {{business}}! What would you like to do?

options.label: Book a store visit
options.description: Pick a day and time that suits you

options.label: Ask for a price
options.description: Tell us what you are looking for

nodes.text: Which collection would you like to see?
✨ Our gold collection: necklaces, bangles, rings and earrings in 22K and 18K. Our team will share photos and prices here.
💎 Our diamond collection: certified solitaires, pendants and bridal sets. Our team will share photos and prices here.
🤍 Our silver collection: anklets, chains, gift items and everyday wear. Our team will share photos and prices here.
Anything else?
Great! Which day would you like to visit? (e.g. Saturday 12 Oct)
What time suits you on {{visitDate}}?

🕙 We are open Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 8 pm, and Sunday 11 am to 6 pm.

description: Qualify enquiries: need, budget, city and contact, then hand to sales.
